title: Smoove Irie  crafts together a track that wastes no time engaging you with his new song “Bobby Valentine”
htmlContent:
Smoove Irie is a gifted singer, rapper, and lyrical genius born and raised in Norwalk. On top of songwriting, he is also gifted with the skills to produce hits in the studio. Driven to motivate, inspire, comfort, and spread love and joy to all who hear it, he releases his must-hear sound titled "Bobby Valentine. "

In his recent song, "Bobby Valentine, Smoove Irie talks about a guy who is done being a player and has his eyes on one girl with whom he's looking to settle down. His music exhibits his versatility and prowess and will cement his style and pave the way for the varied expressions of his musical ideas and artistic craft.
